limitations: Automated source-grounded reconstruction; medication, threshold, referral and safety wording is limited to explicit committed evidence.

user_facing_items.population: Sexually active adolescents and adults with genital, anal or perianal ulcers, anogenital warts, HPV infection or related counselling needs, with pregnancy, immune-status, anatomy and exposure qualifiers.
user_facing_items.setting: Clinical STI evaluation, diagnosis discussion, counselling and clinician-selected management.
user_facing_items.jurisdiction: United States federal public-health guidance requiring UAE epidemiology, laboratory, medicine and reporting adaptation
restrictions: Exact for recording lesion history and examination, differential context, clinician-selected testing, entered wart or HPV findings, partner or STI context and counselling. It does not diagnose an STI, infer sexual exposure, choose treatment or define UAE reporting pathways.
user_facing_items.rationale: Exact phrase located in inspected full source.

user_facing_items.final_wording: Supports clinician-observed wart morphology and site, differential diagnosis, biopsy context when indicated, immune and pregnancy context, and counselling without inferring HPV type or cancer.
